Dijkstra Shortest Path Search on Directed Graphs

Graph Theory & Network Routing

1. Network Topology & Edge Weights

Dijkstra's algorithm determines the shortest path from a starting source node A to all other nodes in a directed graph with non-negative edge weights. Consider the network graph with nodes {A, B, C, D, E} and directed edges: A -> B (weight 4), A -> C (weight 2), C -> B (weight 1), B -> D (weight 5), C -> D (weight 8), C -> E (weight 10), D -> E (weight 2).

FromToWeight
AB4
AC2
CB1
BD5
DE2

The algorithm maintains a priority queue of unvisited nodes, greedily relaxing edges to relax tentative distance labels until destination E is reached with minimum total cost 9.
